clock: none; rows are in arrival order

runs.0.244.0/s1-init: A headless droid (no TUI) starts session S1, takes one prompt, and closes.
runs.0.244.0/s1-load: A second headless droid loads the session that s1-init made, then closes.
runs.linux-0.244.0/s1-init: The s1-init scenario on Linux; the start time is `<boot id>:<ticks>` with the boot id zeroed.
runs.tui-0.244.0/t1-new: The TUI starts S1, then /new: SessionEnd clear for S1, SessionStart resume for S2, a late SessionEnd other for S1, and SessionEnd other for S2 at exit.
runs.tui-0.244.0/t2-resume: The TUI resumes the session t1-new switched to, then exits.
runs.tui-0.244.0/t3-hup: The probe sends the TUI SIGHUP; the log holds only its SessionEnd other.
runs.tui-0.244.0/t3-term: The probe sends the TUI SIGTERM; the log holds only its SessionStart.

note: Logged by a research probe whose hook command recorded every Droid hook with the droid process it captured, the identity the listener keys presence on. Reduced to one row per hook: run, event, session relation, source, reason, and the captured platform and start time. Session relations are per run, so a session one run resumes from another gets a new S number. Scrubbed: session-id prefixes replaced by relations, pids, the hook script's ancestor chain, and the probe's process-table rows removed. Runs that repeat a kept sequence (0.238.0 and Linux 0.238.0 exec runs, s1-load on Linux, recon, t3b, t3c, rep1-rep6, and the 0.238.0 t2/t3 runs) were dropped.
